🤖 Talos triage · confidence: medium

Talos can make mistakes. Please check important information.

Verdict
Treat this as a real Secure-side problem rather than user error — the alert history on the case is not a delivery receipt, and we confirmed the "sent" status is recorded independently of what the mail provider reports back; no known recurring incident matches.

What we checked

  • The status shown on the case is written by the same step that attempts the email, and the mail provider's accept/reject answer is not consulted before writing it — so "shows sent" neither confirms nor rules out an actual send.

  • The recipient list stored against that history row is a cleaned-up copy, not the list configured on the alert: addresses are de-duplicated and any address failing a format check is silently dropped beforehand.

  • The mail provider's own "send failed" message is logged at a level that is switched off in deployed environments, so no failure trace would be visible today even if the send was rejected.

Next

  • Pull the recipient list recorded against this case's alert entry and compare it with the recipients configured on the alert, then check the mail provider's activity feed for those addresses at that timestamp.

  • Turn on the Smart Alert debug trace for this tenant, re-trigger the alert on a test case, and read the resulting trace in the log dashboard.
